root_cause: An earlier direct apply registered migration version 20261027170326 in production without a matching repo file, so the Supabase GitHub integration refused to deploy edge functions. The company link also reused a previous test user id from the stored state record.
fix: Repo file with the same idempotent definition for the registered version; company link always bound to bedrijfsgeheugen-owner.
prevention_rule: Every migration applied directly to production must have a repo file with the same version before the next deploy is attempted.
terminal_rule: After merge, the edge deploy succeeds and create_personal_link returns a redirect_url.
